summary: Now owned by Skyview Equity (from Apr 29, 2026); ~3,200 US hospitality locations
Skyview: "deep experience in software and payments — and a real commitment to leveraging the latest AI capabilities" (Bob Bellack)
Sub-scale, recently carved out; ownership transition may push customers to re-evaluate POS vendors

Lightspeed sold the Upserve U.S. hospitality product line to Skyview Equity in April 2026; the divested scope included about 3,200 U.S. customer locations. (Scope note: The approximately 3,200 locations are the divested product-line scope, not all Lightspeed restaurants.)
